pages.text: A fluctuation that costs entropy ΔS happens with odds $(thing)e^(−ΔS/k)$(). A lone brain that only thinks it remembers a world is far cheaper than a whole low-entropy universe - so in an eternal universe, which observers are likely? That is the measure problem.
Boltzmann Brains fluctuate into the Accretion Frontier by chance. The sure way: an Ergodic Mixer Core and eight Entropy Dice, run for a long time through the Monte Carlo Engine.
